name: Rating
summary: Star rating, read only, in half stars, with the number and the number of reviews as options.
use: Product cards and the product page.
avoid: Giving a rating: that needs a separate input component.
a11y: One name for the whole thing: "4.5 out of 5 stars, 128 reviews" (role=img).
Empty stars have low contrast, but the meaning is in the name and the numbers.
do: Show the number of reviews, so a 5 from 1 review does not mislead.
dont: Stars without a count on a product page.
open: An interactive rating (giving a rating) does not exist yet.
